acceptance_sequence.name: identity
require: candidate HEAD is an ordinary single child of base_candidate_head
candidate has exactly one parent
no merge/rebase/cherry-pick/amend/squash/history rewrite evidence

acceptance_sequence.name: path_delta
require: base_candidate_head -> candidate changes exactly one path
the path is path10_target
status is modified
mode remains 100644 and type remains blob

acceptance_sequence.name: method_boundary
require: all added/deleted lines are inside the three authorized_mutable_methods
imports, helpers, fixtures, class structure and browser methods are unchanged
the other ten portable method bodies are byte-for-byte unchanged
portable method inventory remains exactly 13

acceptance_sequence.name: semantic_oracle
require: download initiation is not retention
retention accepts only exact-copy or byte-exact-file
recoverPublication(override = null) remains GET-only
PUBLICATION ticket uses exact eight-key contract and import is recoveryOnly
publication import never reconstructs publication POST
validation HUMAN ticket/replay remains separate
404 remains non-fingerprinting and unresolved

acceptance_sequence.name: coupled_gate
require: Node 24 node --check lifecycle_publication.js PASS
pytest collect-only for ProductionStudioLifecyclePublicationTests yields exactly 13
ProductionStudioLifecyclePublicationTests yields 13 passed and zero failed/skipped/xfail

acceptance_sequence.name: capture
require: record exact candidate HEAD, TREE, sole parent and path10 blob
record exact changed-path inventory and test evidence
re-read PR #94 and prove it is still OPEN/DRAFT/UNMERGED at immutable R1

acceptance_sequence.name: promotion
require: only after steps 1-6 PASS, count paths 9 and 10 prepared together
prepared count moves from 8/12 to 10/12
path11 carrier may then ordinary non-force fast-forward to the accepted path10 child
verifier carrier remains behind path11 until path11 acceptance
